objective: Test whether training-state-dependent allocation of actor and critic updates improves multi-task VLA PPO under a fixed environment-interaction budget, and whether an LLM controller outperforms statistical rules and its own replayed schedule.
existing_experiments: Keep all already submitted takeover experiments on frozen configuration; complete and audit them first. Do not retarget active jobs.

fixed.reward: native sparse reward; no added subgoal shaping
fixed.sampler: existing Flow-SDE training and fixed ODE evaluation; keep chain log-prob definition unchanged

critic_first.after_critic_pass: Recompute value predictions and GAE before any actor update; retain behavior-policy old log-probs.

inputs: training success counts by task and their denominators
return variance, lengths and terminal/truncation counts
critic return calibration and explained variance with estimator scope specified
old-policy ratio statistics, empirical KL and clipping fraction
actor/critic gradient summaries and prior executed decisions
controller.logging: Freeze prompt/model settings and save complete inputs, replies, decisions, exact applied update counts and failure reasons.

arms: deterministic statistical rule with same action set and same inputs
LLM controller with same action set and same inputs

priority: short_update if recent empirical KL exceeds frozen threshold
critic_first if value fit is worse than a constant baseline over two consecutive informative windows
rule_baseline.calibration: Fit numerical thresholds only from existing training logs and lock before running. No selection using final test outcomes.

common_executor_constraints: All three arms use identical finite-value, trajectory-mask, behavior-log-probability and empirical-KL checks. Numerical checks are implemented in code rather than decided by the LLM.
Critic-only updates leave actor parameters, actor optimizer moments and actor learning-rate schedule unchanged.
All update passes are counted and no arm may exceed four passes per rollout. Compare actual GPU-hours as well as environment interactions.
Preserve optimizer, scheduler, controller history and RNG provenance on resume. Do not claim environment RNG continuity unless saved and restored.
engineering_checks: standard action matches frozen PPO loss, gradients and parameter updates under same precision and grouping
critic-only update preserves actor hash and actor optimizer/scheduler state
GAE after critic update uses current values and unchanged old action log-probabilities
DDP ranks agree on mode and exact pass count
invalid controller response and restart preserve correct finite state and logs

primary_metrics: mean success over three training seeds
per-task success and regressions relative to same-seed standard PPO
evaluation.secondary_checkpoints: Optional fixed iteration10 curves only if included identically for all arms before launch; not used to select the model.
evaluation.interpretation: 500 paired episodes do not establish robustness across training seeds; report both. The historical fixed evaluation set is for comparability, not claimed to be entirely unseen.

replay_control.trigger: Only if the LLM controller shows improvement worth attributing
replay_control.description: Replay a schedule generated on a different training seed, without reading current training-state feedback. Compare against the feedback controller on the same target seed.
replay_control.interpretation: Cross-seed schedule replay tests transfer of a fixed schedule. Exact self-replay on its original seed is only a reproducibility check, not an ablation of feedback.

promotion_criteria: A positive multi-seed effect relative to fixed PPO without a large recurring task-level collapse
An advantage over the same-action statistical rule, not solely over a poor fixed setting
Compare replay results before attributing improvement to feedback-dependent reasoning
If the rule or a fixed/replayed schedule explains the gain, simplify the method and do not claim a necessary LLM contribution

phase_2.condition: Phase1 passes engineering and multi-seed evidence checks
phase_2.scope: Add reward configuration management as a separately registered ablation, starting with weights on existing verifiable progress signals.
constraints: Recompute targets and value fitting consistently after reward version changes
Keep benchmark success definitions and final evaluation independent
Use simulator-verifiable state predicates; visual judgement is advisory until independently validated
phase_2.future_work_not_authorized_by_this_plan: Do not automatically launch phase2 or cross-benchmark expansions from this proposal.

resources.admission: Respect global current-campaign cap and available quota; do not displace existing jobs. Idle Reserved first when verified; otherwise Spot.
resources.submissions: Follow current submission_policy.md: >=15min interval, <=3/hour, <=50/day, <=2 queued account jobs; no unattended automatic retries.
resources.storage: Budget persistent checkpoints and optimizer state before submissions; do not delete old data as part of this proposal.
resources.data: No new expert demonstration collection. Each PPO run still needs its stated on-policy interactions.

implementation_locations.controller: rlinf/b1k_tools/ new opt-in module, separate from current manager v2/v3
implementation_locations.ordering: rlinf/runners/embodied_runner.py: receive rollout -> controller -> optional value update -> compute GAE -> actor/joint update
implementation_locations.config: new frozen config with feature disabled by default

research_positioning.claim: A validation plan, not a claim of a new training paradigm or established effectiveness.

prior_art.name: LLM-ALSO
prior_art.overlap: LLM diagnosis, proposal, validation and reward-shaping adaptation in cooperative MARL
